details: Reports indicate that the United States and Iran have agreed to halt recent military strikes and are scheduled to hold talks in Qatar to address disputes, including those concerning the Strait of Hormuz. While this de-escalation effort aims to reduce geopolitical tensions that could impact global energy markets, the cryptocurrency market has shown a largely muted response. Bitcoin has remained stable, hovering around the $59,700 mark, with analysts noting persistent underlying bearish sentiment. This cautious investor behavior is attributed to broader economic uncertainties and the hawkish stance of the Federal Reserve on interest rates, which continue to pressure risk assets.
title: US-Iran De-escalation Fails to Significantly Boost Crypto Markets

details: The cryptocurrency market experienced a flat trajectory over the past weekend, with total market capitalization dropping to its lowest point since September 2024. This bearish sentiment is influenced by ongoing geopolitical risks, particularly the US military strikes on Iranian targets which raised market concerns. Further pressure is expected from key economic data releases this week, including JOLTs job openings and the June jobs report. Weak economic data could intensify worries about the Federal Reserve's monetary policy, potentially leading to increased rate hike expectations and further downward pressure on risk assets like cryptocurrencies.
title: Crypto Markets Flat Amid Geopolitical Risks and Upcoming Economic Data
